title: ItipDirective
description: ITIP base Archetype for Directive — the governance intent half of the DNA grammar. Inherits gsm/Directive through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Directive statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Directive, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
